LOAD-BEARING, not defensive: normalizeIRI splits on the LAST hash while fromTermIRI splits on the FIRST, so for .../ontology/ems#Effort#status the map misses and the input reaches the inverse -- without this condition the inverse returns {ems, 'Effort#status'} and the physical key becomes ems__Effort#status, reintroducing the very junk key this ticket removes, through the fix's own fallback.
